author: Kushal
problem: Read N (up to 10^18) and print the largest number not greater than N that is both a perfect cube and a palindrome in decimal.
bug_description: Takes int() of the floating-point cube root, which can come out just below the true root for large N, so the largest cube is skipped.

comments.accurate: Starts from the cube root of N and counts down to the first cube that reads the same backwards
comments.wrong_behavior: Starts from the truncated floating-point cube root of N and counts down to the first palindromic cube
comments.wrong_location: Cube-root start verified; check the palindrome test for cubes with an odd number of digits
